description: Armored bulwark - soaks damage behind a hardened exoskeleton. Bear-equivalent spec; Beetle Form is this spec's shapeshift, trading Mana for Rage.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 25 confirmed Fortitude nodes trimmed HARD to a lean 12-node tree per Kyle's bloat direction - this was the single biggest source list of any Venomancer spec, heavy on near-duplicate exoskeleton passives (Empowered/Regrow/Reinforced Exoskeleton, Reconstructive Carapace all did similar armor-stacking things) which were consolidated into fewer, stronger nodes. Exposed Flesh confirmed via tooltip as the Rage-generation mechanic: 'Hostile attacks against you now have a 50% chance to grant a stack of Exposed Flesh. Exposed Flesh generates 10 Rage and increases your Physical Damage taken 3% for 20 seconds, stacking 10 times.'

nodes.name: Exposed Flesh
nodes.description: Hostile attacks against you have a 50% chance to grant a stack of Exposed Flesh, generating 10 Rage.
nodes._source2: unlock_mechanic was a dead flag never read anywhere (the real 'exposed_flesh_stacks' mechanic it was meant to unlock didn't exist in the engine at all) - rebuilt as a real talent-level proc using the new generic stacking support (StatusEffect.max_stacks/stacks, see combat/status_effects.py). on_target=false applies the stacking debuff to the CARRIER (the Venomancer), not the attacker - this is a self-debuff representing exposed armor plating, unlike Venomous Retort's on_target=true poison which hits the attacker. real_time_seconds=20 (an explicit number, not the turn-based-None convention) matches Kyle's tooltip ('for 20 seconds' - a real-world timer, not turn count) - each new stack refreshes this same 20-second window, matching real WoW stacking-debuff behavior where the timer resets off the MOST RECENT application, not the first.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Hostile attacks against you now have a 50% chance to grant a stack of Exposed Flesh. Exposed Flesh Generates 10 Rage and increases your Physical Damage taken 3% for 20 seconds, stacking 10 times.' This spec's core Rage-generation mechanic - the damage-taken-increase risk/reward clause is kept since it matches real WoW tank Rage generation (taking hits fuels your kit).

nodes.name: Impale

nodes.name: Barbed Stinger
nodes.description: Learn Barbed Stinger, a taunt that forces your active Venom to proc against the target.
nodes._source: Built during the DPS niche audit (Oct 2026) - no talent anywhere unlocked Barbed Stinger even though 2 tier-2 talents (Molt, Staggering Blow) already named it as if it existed. Placed at tier 1 so both of its tier-2 modifiers can sit downstream of it, same shape as Impale (tier 1, unlocks Beetle Form) feeding Hivebreak (tier 1, Beetle-Form-gated) one column over. requires_talent=true on the ability itself (see data/abilities/venomancer.json) means this node is the ONLY way to ever learn Barbed Stinger - without it the ability would be permanently unlearnable, the same mistake caught and fixed for Tinker's Defibrillate earlier this session.

nodes.name: Venomous Retort
nodes.description: Melee attacks against you have a 3% chance per rank to poison the attacker.
nodes._source: retort_poison_chance was a dead stat_mods key never read anywhere - converted to a real talent-level proc (same mechanism as Spider Lord). chance is the PER-RANK value (3), scaled by Character._sync_talent_procs to the rank actually spent (3/6/9% across 3 ranks) - see that method's new rank-scaling comment. trigger on_damage_taken + apply_effect(on_target=true) applies the poison DoT to the ATTACKER (passed through as the proc's target via take_damage's new attacker parameter), not the Venomancer - this is a retaliation effect, not a self-buff. Fixed potency=15/duration=3 (a modest, non-scaling poison tick) rather than reusing a real damage-dealing spell's own effect_value, since a passive retaliation proc shouldn't scale with the Venomancer's own spell power/gear the way an intentional cast does.
